:::{#def-prediction-rule}
#### Prediction rule <!-- prose-allow: prediction rule -->

<!-- prose-allow: prediction rule -->
A **prediction rule** is a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\emodmem$
that is used to [predict](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) the outcome
at a new [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$.
Its [prediction](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) is $\emodmem\paren{\predvar}$.

In words,
the prediction rule takes a new covariate value
and returns the fitted model's value there.

:::
